analogue: Gas-phase cross-reactions of oxygenated peroxy radicals from α-pinene ozonolysis, yielding low-volatility organic dimers.
citation: Quantitative constraints on autoxidation and dimer formation from direct probing of monoterpene-derived peroxy radical chemistry
evidence: Speciated RO₂ and gas-phase C16–20 dimer measurements, together with concentration and radical-chemistry perturbations, implicated RO₂ cross-reactions in dimer production.
difference: An o-cresol-derived reaction partner, the identity of the mixed product, immediate complete transfer to stable aerosol and a rate coefficient for lumped G_A and G_C were not established.
